en.headline: Court of Final Appeal quashes autistic man's flag insult convictions
en.dek: Five judges unanimously overturned the 2022 convictions of Wong Chun-lok after finding lower courts failed to properly assess his intent and wrongly excluded medical evidence of autism.
body: The Court of Final Appeal on Friday unanimously allowed the appeal of Wong Chun-lok and quashed his convictions for insulting the national flag and the regional flags.

Wong, who has autism, was convicted after a trial of one count of insulting the national flag and two counts of insulting the regional flags for pulling and bending flagpoles at three locations in Sham Shui Po on National Day in 2022. He was sentenced to a rehabilitation centre. The High Court later dismissed his appeal against conviction.

In a judgment delivered on 27 November, the five judges held that both offences require proof of specific intent: the accused must have deliberately intended to damage the dignity of the flags. Mere disregard of the consequences is not enough. The more trivial the act, the more conclusive the evidence of intent must be.

The Court found that the trial magistrate and the High Court judge had not adequately considered whether Wong acted with the required insulting intent. It also held that the High Court wrongly refused to admit new expert evidence showing that Wong's autism and hyperactivity made him susceptible to impulsively bending flagpoles when affected by rows of fluttering flags.
The judges said the failure to properly evaluate the intent issue and the exclusion of the medical evidence amounted to a serious miscarriage of justice. They ordered all three convictions set aside.

zh.headline: 終審法院撤銷自閉症男子侮辱國旗及區旗定罪
zh.dek: 五名法官一致裁定黃俊樂上訴得直，指下級法院未妥善評估其犯罪意圖，並錯誤拒絕接納有關自閉症的醫療證據。
body: 終審法院星期五一致裁定黃俊樂上訴得直，撤銷其侮辱國旗及區旗的三項定罪。
黃俊樂患有自閉症，因 2022年國慶日在深水埗三處拉扯及屈曲旗杆，經審訊後被裁定一項侮辱國旗及兩項侮辱區旗罪名成立，並被判入更生中心。高等法院其後駁回其定罪上訴。
終院在 11月 27日頒下的判詞指出，侮辱國旗及區旗罪行均須證明犯罪者蓄意作出侮辱行為，即決意損害旗幟的尊嚴；僅證明罔顧後果並不足夠。行為愈不起眼，證明侮辱意圖的證據便須更為確實。
法官認為原審裁判官及高院法官對黃俊樂是否具備侮辱意圖考慮不周。終院亦指高院錯誤拒絕接納新的專家證據，該證據支持黃因自閉症及過動症，受一排排飄動旗幟影響而衝動屈曲旗杆的解釋。
終院表示，下級法院未能妥善處理意圖爭議及拒絕接納新證據，構成嚴重不公，因此下令撤銷全部定罪。
